review_findings: Dense-loss selection uses runtime row count relative to eight warps in a 256-thread block; cooperative team count and thread width derive from rows and classes.
Both loss paths traverse all rows/classes using supplied strides and offsets, accumulating stable centered log-softmax in double precision.
Quantized matmul validates documented bit widths, packing/group divisibility, dtype modes and buffer ownership; shape and stride metadata drive every output.
No parity cell IDs, input-value branches or exact benchmark-shape whitelist enters the reviewed loss or quantized-matmul dispatch.
